answer: Each identity seals a signed daily commitment under a Wesolowski VDF tuned to 4 sequential hours on one core. A quorum of 7 peers, drawn from the beacon value published at epoch zenith, verifies each proof in under 2 seconds on a laptop. Thirty consecutive valid days unlock rewards; one missing proof resets the streak and burns a 25 token bond. Cloning 10,000 identities costs 1.2 million core-hours, about $48,000 rented, with 250,000 tokens exposed to slashing. Rushing it resembles coaxing a meadow to bloom overnight, since no whisper of extra hardware shortens the sunrise.
